source: measured by the rare-path forced-path harness (organizer image, -O3 -fno-tree-vectorize -mgeneral-regs-only)
full_results: kept with the work, not in this package (the full file exceeds the package file limit)
subject: worst-case Ir of the unbatched rare-path primitives of the P-256 rho kernel (step.c)
platform: linux/arm64 container curvesma-reference-count, valgrind --tool=callgrind --collect-atstart=no, Ir between two CALLGRIND_TOGGLE_COLLECT
units: Ir per call = Callgrind instructions of one call: the slope between N = 1000 and N = 2000 calls, minus the harness loop measured without a call or with an empty call (the cheaper), so the call, argument setup, the wrapper's tail branch, the body and the return are included and up to about 3 instructions of loop control may remain: a figure slightly above the body alone

same_class_max.note: the library memcmp (32 bytes) costs 26 when the first 16 bytes differ and 32 otherwise; rare_anchor calls it, the other sites inline a limb chain

escape_max_2.note: the escape is the doubling of the canonical point of the least-key member: least-key search (loop types t0..t3, te), even-y normalisation (parity), then add_single(c, c)

escape_max_65.note: the escape is the doubling of the canonical point of the least-key member: least-key search (loop types t0..t3, te), even-y normalisation (parity), then add_single(c, c)

esc_seen_max.note: the diagnostic repeat counter: every ring state (0..5 keys held) and every position of a hit

rare_function_forced_calls.method: the real rare_2cycle and rare_anchor, compiled from the kernel source, on forged walks (adders chosen so that the unbatched step maps each point to the next), costs attributed by instruction address; callees (add_single, finv, memcmp) are separate rows, 'own' is the function itself with everything the compiler inlined (the escape's search and negation, the distinguished-point tests, the repeat counter, record copies, call setup)
rare_function_forced_calls.forced_inside_the_function: loop type of the minimum search (limb 0..3 first differing), odd y of the least member, ring state (empty, full without a match, full with the match in the last slot)

rare_anchor.note: same code except how a link address is formed (one add more or fewer on the negation path) and, for rare_2cycle (a constant-propagated clone in the kernel), the register allocation of a few instructions

rare_2cycle.note: same code except how a link address is formed (one add more or fewer on the negation path) and, for rare_2cycle (a constant-propagated clone in the kernel), the register allocation of a few instructions

own_ir_affine_in_len.from: len 2 and 65, maximum over worst=0..4 and ring modes 0..2

formulas.rare_2cycle: own + 2*add_max (the f_single and the escape's doubling); the same_class chain, the escape's search and negation and the repeat counter are inlined in own
formulas.rare_anchor: own(len) + (len + 1) * add_max + len * memcmp_max for a cycle of len classes (len <= 65): len f_single, one doubling in the escape, len library memcmp; own(len) is the instructions of rare_anchor itself and of the escape function it calls (control plus the minimum search, the negation, the distinguished-point tests, the diagnostic repeat counter, record copies, call setup), callees add_single, finv and memcmp excluded

rare_function_forced_calls.control_overhead: the charged OVERHEAD of 1,024 instructions per rare event and per look-ahead step is far above the measured own cost: at most 191 for a 2-cycle check and 107 + 59 per cycle member for an anchor check

equality_bounded_vs_original: coverage escape: zero-return=37630 point=262370 y_even_min=168963 y_odd_min=131037 min_at_0=69751 min_elsewhere=230249
coverage: point_is_dp false=1524628 true=475372; b_lt a>=b=1084173 a<b=915827

bounding_variants: bounded.h is generated by gen_bounded.py from the text of src/step3.c: add_single, f_single, escape, same_class and point_is_dp are copied and feq/fcmp/&& are replaced by branch-free routines (or-reduced xor, borrow chain, mask select, & instead of &&); the remaining branches are the control variants that are forced. The routines carry nop padding (PAD_FEQ=5, PAD_LT=0, PAD_DP=1) so each bounded variant costs at least as much as the original on every forced path.

branch_kinds_and_handling.data dependent: early-exit comparison: all exit positions are forced one by one (classes a0..a3, z0..z3, s0..s3, t0..t3, worst=1..4) and a bounded variant replaces the chain by a straight-line routine that is padded to cost at least as much as the longest path; the maximum of both is reported
branch_kinds_and_handling.control: every outcome forced by chosen inputs (classes d, zz, parity 0/1, scenarios) and the maximum is taken
branch_kinds_and_handling.input independent: same decision on every call (constant exponent, or a counter fixed by len); the Ir per call is identical for all inputs, which the seed and N checks confirm
branch_kinds_and_handling.error exit (abort), not on a measured pa: reached only on arithmetic impossibilities (exceptional counter, abort); not part of a rare-path charge

field_routines.p256_field.h: k_mul, k_sqr, k_add, k_sub, k_to, k_from: straight-line assembly ending in csel/masks; no b./cb/tb instruction (checked: none in the file)
field_routines.p256_sub.h: k_subb and k_sub2 contain b.cs (add p back on borrow, data dependent) but step3.c uses only the branch-free k_subb_bl and k_sub2_bl, and only in batch_step; the rare paths call neither

library_memcmp: glibc memcmp as resolved in the organizer image (the code at libc.so.6 0x9bfc0..0x9c068): data-dependent branch is 'first 16 bytes differ' (ccmp then b.ne); length branches are fixed by n = 32. All 33 outcomes (first differing byte 0..31, equal) are forced and measured: 17 instructions when byte 0..15 differs, 23 otherwise (body, PLT stub not counted by Callgrind)

files.harness.c: primitive harness (includes step.c with main renamed; wrappers, forced variants, drivers, equality tests)
files.harness_rare.c: whole-function harness for rare_2cycle and rare_anchor on forged walks
files.gen_bounded.py / bounded.h: bounded copies of the primitives generated from the text of step.c

notes_and_limitations: ir_per_call includes the call, the wrapper's tail branch and up to 3 instructions of measuring loop; it is slightly above the body alone.

Every control path of add_single (10), the memcmp (33 outcomes) and esc_seen (every ring state and hit) is enumerated; the minimum search is covered by the loop types, which are additive per iteration.
The harness copy of the rare functions differs from the kernel's by at most 3 instructions per call (address formation, register allocation); 3 is added to every own figure.
The long path of the distinguished-point test after an escape adds at most 3 instructions per rare call and is inside OVERHEAD.
The library memcmp outcomes are those of the glibc in the organizer image.
